WS::collect
Description
WS::collect frame Collects the entire Websocket frame payload.
WS::collect frame Collects an amount of Websocket frame payload,
optionally specified with the argument.
Syntax
WS::collect ('frame' (LENGTH)? )
WS::collect (‘frame’ (LENGTH)? )
Valid During
WS_CLIENT_FRAME WS_SERVER_FRAME WS_CLIENT_DATA WS_SERVER_DATA
Examples
when
WS_CLIENT_FRAME
{
WS
::
collect
frame
}
when
WS_CLIENT_FRAME
{
WS
::
collect
frame
1000
}
Change Log
